The '''Jeweler''' is a [[villager]] profession that sets gems into [[jewelry]] and buys gems back for [[Obol]]s. It replaces the {{MCW|Toolsmith|toolsmith}}, and its job site block is the [[Smithing Table]]. Trading with a jeweler is the only way to obtain earrings, the Ruby Circlet and the Hepatizon Laurel in survival: the pack's loot tables for these items are not used by any chest or mob.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/equipment/misc/opal_earrings.json}}</ref>

All trades can be used 999 times before restocking, and each level offers all of its trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/trade_set/toolsmith/level_1.json}}</ref>

=== Jewelry ===
Each piece of jewelry costs obols plus the gem or material it is made from:
* Novice: [[Opal Earrings]] (4 obols and an [[Opal]]), and the decorative [[Diamond Earrings]], [[Amethyst Earrings]] and [[Lapis Earrings]] (1 obol and 2 of the material each).
* Apprentice: [[Ruby Circlet]] (4 obols and a [[Ruby]]).
* Journeyman: [[Amber Earrings]] (8 obols and an [[Amber]]).
* Expert: [[Hepatizon Laurel]] (10 obols and 2 [[Hepatizon Alloy]]) and [[Topaz Earrings]] (14 obols and a [[Topaz]]).
The earrings and circlet come with their intrinsic effect already applied; see each item's page for what it does.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/1/opal_earrings.json}}</ref>

The villager XP of the jewelry trades rises with each level: 10 at Novice, 70 at Apprentice, 150 at Journeyman, and 250 and 200 at Expert.

=== Buying gems ===
At Master level the jeweler buys gems for obols:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/5/sell_topaz.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Gem !! Obols
|-
| {{ItemLink|Topaz}} || 10
|-
| {{ItemLink|Ruby}} || 8
|-
| {{ItemLink|Opal}} || 4
|-
| {{ItemLink|Amber}} || 4
|}
These trades give no villager XP.

Like every villager, a jeweler that has been traded with also buys its [[favorite food]] once.
